direction.msg: Two outputs or two inputs connected.
direction.fix: Connect an output to an input.

signal-mismatch.fix: Check the port or add a converter.

level-mic-to-line.msg: Mic level into a line input (+4 dBu).
level-mic-to-line.fix: Use a preamp or a mic input.

level-line-to-mic.msg: Line level into a mic input: risk of clipping.
level-line-to-mic.fix: Use a line input or a pad.

level-phono-to-line.msg: Phono output (cartridge, no RIAA correction) into a non-phono input.
level-phono-to-line.fix: Use a phono input or a phono preamp.

level-line-to-phono.msg: Non-phono signal into a phono input: overload and wrong RIAA correction.
level-line-to-phono.fix: Use a line input or switch the input to line.

level-speaker-to-line.msg: Amplified speaker output into a low-level input: risk of damage.
level-speaker-to-line.fix: Connect the speaker output to a passive speaker.

level-line-to-speaker.msg: Unamplified signal into a passive speaker.
level-line-to-speaker.fix: Add an amplifier or use a powered speaker.

adapter-needed.fix: Plan an adapter or a dedicated cable.

input-busy.msg: Several sources on the same input.
input-busy.fix: Use another input or a mixer.

output-busy.msg: This digital or network output feeds several destinations.
output-busy.fix: Add a distribution amp, a switch or a router.

output-split.msg: Analog output shared between several inputs.
output-split.fix: Check impedance or use a splitter.

phantom-missing.msg: Condenser mic on an input without 48 V phantom power.
phantom-missing.fix: Use a mic input with phantom power, or an external phantom supply.

phantom-unknown.msg: Condenser mic: check that the input provides 48 V phantom.
phantom-unknown.fix: Enable 48 V on the input, or set the port's phantom capability.

cable-mismatch.msg: The cable "{{cable}}" does not connect {{from}} to {{to}}.
cable-mismatch.fix: Choose a compatible cable in the link inspector.

pair-busy.msg: Pair {{pair}} of multicore {{cable}} is already used by another link.
pair-busy.fix: Choose a free pair in the link inspector.

pair-range.msg: Pair {{pair}} does not exist: multicore {{cable}} has {{pairs}} pairs.
pair-range.fix: Choose a pair between 1 and the pair count, or enlarge the multicore.

pair-missing.msg: Link assigned to multicore {{cable}} without a pair number.
pair-missing.fix: Choose the pair used in the link inspector.

channels-over.msg: {{n}} channels carried for a declared capacity of {{max}}.
channels-over.fix: Reduce the number of flows, or check the port capacity.

dock.missingPower: {{n}} item(s) without declared power: minimum total.
dock.noMulticore: No multicore. A multicore is not a block: it is a cable carrying several links. Select those links on the diagram (Shift+click), then “Route through a multicore” in the inspector. Stageboxes are in the library (Audio > Stageboxes).
dock.multicoreHelp: To fill a multicore: select links (Shift+click) and pick it in the inspector. Cables view (above the diagram): one line per multicore.
dock.reactivateProject_one: Re-enable this check for the diagram
dock.reactivateProject_other: Re-enable this check for the diagram ({{count}} links)
dock.reactivateLink: Re-enable this check for this link

ai.title: AI Assistant
ai.intro: The assistant helps you build and check your diagram. It only places equipment from the library and has its proposals checked by the rules engine. It stays off until you set it up: local AI on your computer, or your own AI account.
ai.hello: Ask a question or describe the system you need. Proposed additions are shown as a preview: nothing changes until you accept.
ai.desktopOnly: The assistant works in the desktop app: it sends the requests and keeps the key in the system keychain.
ai.placeholder: Your question (Enter to send, Shift+Enter for a new line)
ai.sentTo: Your messages and the relevant parts of the diagram are sent to {{provider}}.

layout.title: Proposed page layout
layout.tooSmall: A device does not fit this page size. Choose a larger size or shorten its label.
layout.hint: Connected ports are shown; unused ports remain available. Routing notes follow the equipment. The chosen page size is saved only when applying the proposal. Export as multiple pages to preserve this size.

ai.proposalIssues_one: {{count}} rules engine warning on the proposed links
ai.proposalIssues_other: {{count}} rules engine warnings on the proposed links
ai.applyHint: Applying is a single step: Ctrl+Z undoes it.
ai.proposalStale: The diagram changed since the proposal: it was not applied. Ask the assistant again.

setup.title: AI assistant: setup
setup.chooseHint: Two options, same assistant. You can switch at any time.
setup.localDesc: Free, offline, no data leaves the computer. Decent quality, limited by the model size. Needs a fairly recent computer.
setup.accountDesc: Use your API key with an external provider. Internet and provider billing according to your plan.
setup.serverHint: Pick the software that runs the model on your computer, then detect it. It must be running with at least one model installed (able to call functions).
setup.noModel: Connected, but no model is installed on this server.
setup.localModelHint: Prefer a multilingual model that can call functions (tools).
setup.testHint: Check that the model responds and can use AV Diagram tools.
setup.testQuestion: What is the nominal level of a professional balanced audio line?
setup.providerHint: Pick the provider of your AI account.
setup.subscriptionWarn: A chat subscription (Claude Pro or Max, ChatGPT Plus, Gemini) does not include API access. You need an API key, billed separately, per use.
setup.createHint: Open the {{provider}} console, sign in, enable API billing, then create a key and copy it.
setup.geminiNote: Gemini offers a limited free tier. Check its terms, in particular how your data may be used.
setup.keyHint: The key is stored in the system's secure keychain, never in a file. AV Diagram never shows it again.
setup.keyPresent: A key is stored for this provider.
setup.keyOptional: Optional key, for a server that does not require one.

shape.spaces: The key contains spaces: check the copy and paste.
shape.prefix: A key from this provider normally starts with "{{prefix}}". Check the copy and paste.

setup.connectHint: A small request (model list) checks the key, billing and access to the service.
setup.costHint: Each question is billed by the provider according to its length and the length of the reply. See the rates on its console.
setup.dataHint: Sent to {{provider}}: your messages, a summary of the diagram and the device sheets the assistant reads. Processing may take place outside the European Union.
setup.consent: I agree to send this data to {{provider}}.
setup.managedHint: Pick the llama-server program (llama.cpp archive for your system) and a .gguf model. AV Diagram starts the server on your computer (127.0.0.1) when you ask a question, and stops it on exit.
setup.launching: Starting llama-server and loading the model (up to 3 min)…
setup.toolTestHint: This test uses an empty fictional diagram, without any data from your project. It may take several minutes.

collab.title: Collaborative Session
collab.hint: Several computers work on the same project at the same time over the local network (venue network, office, VPN). No data leaves the network, no account.
collab.name: Your name (seen by others)
collab.hostDesktopOnly: Working together uses the AV Diagram desktop app (Windows or macOS), installed on each computer. Windows and Mac computers can work together in the same session.
collab.hostHint: Open a lobby with the current diagram. Welcome guests, assign their layers, then start the session.
collab.joinHint: Choose a host on the local network, then enter the code they give you.
collab.joinWarning: The session project replaces the project open on this computer: save it first if needed.

joinRequirements.name: Enter your name to join the session.
joinRequirements.host: Select a session from the list or enter an address in the advanced options.
joinRequirements.code: Enter the 6-digit code provided by the host.

collab.firewall: Allow AV Diagram on the private network. Sessions use TCP port {{port}}; host discovery uses UDP port 4456.
collab.undoHint: Undo (Ctrl+Z) only reverts your own changes.

status.reconnecting: Connection lost, reconnecting… (you can keep working)

error.code: Code refused (or too many attempts: wait a minute).
error.timeout: No answer from the host: check the address, port and firewall.
error.version: Incompatible versions. Install the same recent AV Diagram version on every computer.

collab.backup: This computer can take over if the host disconnects (it then opens the session on port 4455)
collab.relayHint: This computer hosts the backup session and keeps all changes. The original computer rejoins this session when it returns; hosting is not transferred automatically.

resume.title: Interrupted session
resume.hintHost: You were hosting “{{name}}” (state saved on {{date}}). Resuming reopens the session with the same code: participants reconnect on their own and their changes are merged.
resume.hintGuest: You were taking part in “{{name}}” (state saved on {{date}}). Resuming reopens this project and reconnects as soon as a relay answers.

layers.title: Reserved layers
layers.hint: The host assigns layers to guests. Guests see everything and edit only from an assigned layer. Their general view is read-only. The host can edit everything.

chat.title: Session chat
chat.placeholder: Message (Enter to send, Shift+Enter: new line)

notice.hostLost: Host unreachable. Your work is kept on this computer; you can keep working, reconnection is automatic.
notice.relayLost: This computer's relay is not answering; retrying.
notice.reconnected: Reconnected: changes made during the outage are merged.
notice.relayActive: Backup relay active: the other participants reconnect to this computer.
notice.tookOver: The host is not answering: this computer took over ({{address}}). The others reconnect automatically.
notice.handedBack: The original host is back: the session moves back to it.
notice.ended: The host ended the session. The project stays open on this computer.
notice.kicked: The host removed you from the session. The project stays open on this computer.
notice.locked: Change refused: the {{layer}} layer is reserved by {{name}}.
notice.accessDenied: Change refused: use a layer assigned by the host. Shared settings and the general view are reserved for the host.
notice.returnDeferred: The original host is available again. This session stays hosted here to preserve all changes.
notice.joinedRelay: The session continues on the backup computer. You joined its current document; that computer remains the host.

lobby.label: Lobby
lobby.invite: Guests select this session in their network search. Give them the code above.
lobby.assignAfterJoin: Guests appear here when they connect. You can then assign their layers before starting.
lobby.guestWaiting: You are connected. The host is assigning roles and will start the session. The diagram is read-only until then.

exportPdf.title: Export the PDF sheet
exportPdf.titleBlockHint: Title block fields for this issue. They are prefilled from the project and from this computer's template (Settings, Title block template), and kept in the project.
exportPdf.noTemplate: No title block template on this computer (company, logo): fill it once in Settings, Title block template tab.
exportPdf.changeTitle: Size changed: {{from}} to {{to}}. What should happen to the diagram?
exportPdf.choiceFitHint: Each sheet fits on one page; the largest diagram is printed at about {{scale}} % of its print size.
exportPdf.choiceTileHint_one: The diagram stays at {{scale}} %: {{count}} {{paper}} page in total.
exportPdf.choiceTileHint_other: The diagram stays at {{scale}} % and may overflow: {{count}} {{paper}} pages in total, to assemble (marks A1, B1...).

mode.page: Fitted page (sheet shown on the diagram)

exportPdf.fitHint: Each sheet is reduced if needed to fit one page. Small diagrams are not enlarged. Estimated scale: {{scale}}%. The working canvas stays unchanged.
exportPdf.tileHint_one: Estimate: {{count}} {{paper}} page at the selected scale. The final count uses displayed dimensions.
exportPdf.tileHint_other: Estimate: {{count}} {{paper}} pages (up to {{max}} per sheet). The final count uses displayed dimensions.
exportPdf.watermarkImages: Also apply to PNG and SVG exports
exportPdf.zoneDiagramHint: Burnt into the diagram pixels: it cannot be removed without retouching the image.
exportPdf.zoneSheetHint: Drawn as text across the whole sheet, title block included: visible everywhere, but a PDF editor can delete it. Combine with protection.
exportPdf.protectHint: Without an open password, the PDF opens everywhere and the rights above are enforced by readers (Acrobat, Preview, browsers): it is a deterrent. With an open password, the content is unreadable without it (AES-256). Empty owner password: random, nobody can lift the restrictions. Passwords are not saved.
exportPdf.protectDesktopOnly: Protection is done by the desktop app.
exportPdf.samePasswords: Both passwords must differ: the owner password lifts all restrictions.
exportPdf.recipients: Named watermark: recipients (one per line, optional)
exportPdf.recipientsPlaceholder:
City of Lyon - J. Martin
Lighting crew - S. Petit
exportPdf.recipientsHint_one: {{count}} file, in the recipient's name. The name replaces {recipient} (appended to the text otherwise).
exportPdf.recipientsHint_other: {{count}} files, one per recipient, saved in the chosen folder. Each name replaces {recipient} (appended to the text otherwise): if a copy leaks, the watermark identifies it.

levelHint.none: the PDF opens, copies and edits freely; only the watermark, if on, remains.
levelHint.deterrent: the PDF opens everywhere; copy and editing are blocked by common readers, but a specialised tool can lift these restrictions.
levelHint.strong: content encrypted (AES-256), unreadable without the open password. Send it through another channel than the PDF.

exportPdf.pageHint: The sheet edges are shown as dashed lines behind the diagram, title block and legend included. The sheet follows the diagram: 100% while it fits, enlarged (smaller scale) beyond. F key: show the whole sheet.
exportPdf.canvasHint: The canvas keeps fixed pages at 100%. Dashed lines mark the drawing area, excluding margins, legend and title block. Overflow adds pages; the export choice never moves equipment.

guide.title: Step by step

save.title: Save and export
save.text: Save an .avd file (or choose a folder in Settings > Saving), then export the PDF for the team.

sources.title: Add the sources
sources.text: Microphones, instruments, players: double-click in the library (or drag onto the diagram). For several items, select the block then “Add copies”.

destination.title: Add the destination
destination.text: Console, stagebox, recorder: where the signals go.

connect.title: Connect
connect.text: Drag from an output (dot on the right of a block) to an input (dot on the left): compatible inputs light up. To connect everything at once, in order: “Connect in series”.

check.title: Check
check.text: Errors (two outputs connected, incompatible signal) and warnings (mic level into a +4 dBu line input…) are in the Alerts tab at the bottom.

tips.drag: Drag on empty space: selection box. Wheel: scroll; Ctrl + wheel: zoom; F: fit all.
tips.connect: Hover a port: its signal, level and connector are shown.
tips.box: Shift + click or Shift + box: add to or remove from the selection. Esc: deselect all.
tips.right: Right-click: multicore, connect in series, align, duplicate, delete.
tips.zone: Zone button: marks an area (stage, control room); blocks placed inside get its code.

guide.nextHint: Copies are stacked below this block, already selected: continue with “Connect in series”.
guide.empty1: Find an item in the library on the left, then double-click it (or drag it here).
guide.empty2: Drag from an output (right of a block) to an input (left of another).
guide.empty3: The “Step by step” panel on the right guides you to the export.

engineering.invalid: Invalid value. Correct the input; the project retains the previous value.
engineering.flowsHint: Aggregate bandwidth entered for this cable. Routing, multicast, redundancy and live traffic are not inferred. Tagged VLANs are documented; only native VLANs are compared.
engineering.networkHint: IPv4 addressing, VLANs and declared budgets. This view does not configure devices or measure the network.
engineering.ipCount: {{count}} interfaces with an address out of {{total}}. A blank cell means unknown / not entered.
engineering.noPorts: No matching ports in the project.
engineering.noAlerts: No inconsistency detected in the entered values. Blank cells still need documentation.
engineering.moreAlerts: Only the first 200 items are displayed.
engineering.powerHint: Budget of declared input power, including cards. Assign each load to a circuit and phase, and enter the power factor for the whole assembly. Line-to-neutral voltage, no diversity factor. This is a preparation budget, not a protection or electrical compliance check.
engineering.unphased: {{count}} loads without a usable phase: excluded from the displayed current.
engineering.unassignedCount: {{count}} equipment without a circuit. Current uses only known powers and power factors; ≥ indicates an incomplete budget.
engineering.syncHint: Declare the protocol, domain and role for each clock port. Checks compare declarations; they do not simulate PTP election or actual signal distribution.
engineering.intercomHint: Document channels and groups on project ports. The matrix represents physical cables, not the internal programming of an intercom system.
engineering.matrixHint: Click to connect or remove a cable. Synoptic compatibility checks still apply. Undo restores the link.
engineering.reportHint: Tables are paginated automatically for the selected format. Complete information remains available in Excel.

audioProduction.video: Video mixer — streaming path to define
audioProduction.routingTitle: PROGRAMME ROUTING — configure on the devices
audioProduction.liveTitle: LIVE ROUTING — configure on the devices
audioProduction.etherSound: Bidirectional EtherSound link; no ordinary Ethernet switch or implicit Dante stream.
audioProduction.acoustic: Guitar: place the microphone in front of the amplifier speaker for acoustic pickup. Never connect a power output to a microphone input.
audioProduction.diSettings: Machines: one passive DI per audio output; set PAD and gain for the actual machine output level. Machines and sockets are generic placeholders to confirm.
audioProduction.auxOnly: Headphone AUX sends only; disable ST and any bus sent back to the M7CL
audioProduction.programmeMix: Programme ST: interview microphones + live L/R + media L/R. MATRIX 1/2 receive ST L/R only for the recorder copy. Pair L/R channels and maintain their pan.
audioProduction.returnMix: Stereo MIX 3/4 to 01V96: presenter microphone + media/jingles only. Exclude live L/R inputs and any bus or effect containing them.
audioProduction.speakerMix: Stereo MIX 1/2 for interview speakers: live mix + media/jingles only. Exclude ALL interview microphones, including effect returns containing them.
audioProduction.liveMix: 01V96 ST to M7CL: vocals + guitar amplifier microphone + machine DIs only. Exclude the presenter/media return from ST and every bus sent back to M7CL.
audioProduction.headphoneMix: Headphones 1: stereo AUX 1/2; headphones 2: stereo AUX 3/4. Each pair receives vocals, guitar, machines and presenter/media return. Pair AUX buses, use pre-fader sends and set an independent balance for each musician.
audioProduction.headphoneSelect: Headphone channel {{n}}: select MAIN {{n}}, leave DIRECT IN unplugged.
audioProduction.headampSettings: HA8000: channel 1 selects MAIN 1 (AUX 1/2), channel 2 selects MAIN 2 (AUX 3/4); leave DIRECT IN unplugged. Individual volumes do not replace two independent AUX mixes.
audioProduction.phantomSettings: 01V96: enable the condenser microphone’s required 48 V only after checking all devices sharing its four-input phantom group. Use INPUT 13/14 for line returns, without phantom. Set gains; AV Diagram performs no physical switching.
audioProduction.phases: Phases: interview, songs, questions between songs. Keep presenter and media returns in both headphone mixes during songs and questions. Prepare and check scene recalls and appropriate microphone mutes.
audioProduction.stageboxSettings: {{n}} SB168-ES: daisy chain M7CL OUT → SB1 IN, then SB1 OUT → SB2 IN if used. IDs 1/2, daisy-chain mode; check AUTO CONFIGURE and 48 kHz. SB1 inputs → CH1–16, SB2 → CH17–32. SB1 OUTPUT 1/2 = MIX 1/2; set other outputs as listed. Check the device patches.
audioProduction.localPatch: No stagebox: patch the used OMNI IN sockets to their CH channels. Assign OMNI OUT 7/8 to MIX 1/2 for the speakers.
audioProduction.recorderSettings: DR-40: XLR-to-TRS cables, EXT IN set to LINE, phantom off; record stereo L/R. Check input level and headroom (+20 dBu maximum input).
audioProduction.manualSettings: AV Diagram proposes wiring and instructions; it does not configure or control consoles, the recorder or streaming.
audioProduction.loopAssumption: Assumption to confirm: {{n}} mono machine outputs, each through a DI; actual machine quantities and connectors remain to be specified.
audioProduction.headphoneAssumption: Assumption: two independently balanced stereo headphone mixes.
audioProduction.stageboxAssumption: Proposal: {{n}} SB168-ES; check physical locations and cable lengths before applying.
audioProduction.genericAssumption: Generic blocks represent functions, not verified manufacturer specifications. Default microphones and interface choices can be changed before applying.
audioProduction.videoBoundary: Scope: audio up to the video mixer inputs. Cameras, encoding and Twitch access remain to be defined; online streaming is not configured.
audioProduction.invalidCounts: Choose 1–10 interview microphones, 1–8 machine outputs and 0, 1 or 2 stageboxes.
audioProduction.consolesRequired: This documented workflow uses M7CL-48ES and the original 01V96. Specify references for another architecture; consoles are never silently replaced.
audioProduction.capacity: Insufficient {{level}} capacity on {{ref}}. No additions proposed.
audioProduction.proposalReady: Proposal prepared: {{equipment}} devices and {{links}} links, with mixes and instructions in the three zone notes. Review the assumptions below before applying.
audioProduction.roleMismatch: Template {{id}} does not fulfil the required role: {{role}}.
audioProduction.pending: A complete production is already in preview. To change its assumptions, click Discard, then request the production again with your clarifications. Apply it to keep this proposal. No second production was added.
audioProduction.monitorPlacement: Place both loudspeakers back from the set, outside the camera frame. Check their orientation, microphone separation and volume to limit acoustic spill.
